description: nf-core/fetchngs input is a single-column CSV/TSV of accession IDs (SRR/SRX/SRP/GSE/GSM/PRJ). Used as a fallback when ENA cannot serve direct FASTQ URLs.

pipeline.name: nf-core/fetchngs
pipeline.core_rule: One accession per line under the column header `accession`.

validation_rules: Each line is one accession; supported prefixes: SRR, SRX, SRP, SRS, ERR, ERX, ERP, ERS, DRR, DRX, DRP, DRS, GSE, GSM, PRJ*.
fetchngs does NOT carry through arbitrary input columns to its emitted downstream samplesheet — extra columns will be silently dropped.

population_priority: Emit one row per accession; do not invent extra metadata columns.
